title: Nourishing Slovakian Beef Fondue
description: A citrusy and creamy Slovakian dish featuring dried cranberries and rest-meat, perfect for a special occasion.

ingredients.name: beef strips
ingredients.notes: rest meat, sliced into thin strips

instructions: Heat the fondue pot to 325 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the lemon juice, heavy cream, grated cheddar cheese, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced beef strips to the fondue pot and cook for 3-4 minutes, or until browned.
Add the chopped onion and minced garlic to the fondue pot and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the dried cranberries and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the beef and onion mixture to the bowl with the cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Return the mixture to the fondue pot and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and the mixture is smooth.
Serve the fondue hot, with assorted vegetables and bread for dipping.
